objective: Implement frozen combat batch items 1/3/4 plus exact shared sling damage/type hooks. Do not run commands, game, servers, browser, tests, or checks. Data/schema edits are handled separately by root. Only the specified files may be edited.

edits.instructions: Change Ent.sprite to Phaser.GameObjects.Image | Phaser.GameObjects.Sprite. Add optional burningUntil?:number and burningFx?:Phaser.GameObjects.Graphics to Ent. Add Mods optional slingDamageMult, explosionRadiusMult, poisonChance,curseChance numeric fields. Add fx.label(x:number,y:number,value:string):Phaser.GameObjects.Image. Do not otherwise change interface.
Add optional weaponId?:string to existing kill event payload; retain all other fields.

Tuning.status retains existing fields and adds slingStatusSteps:number; burning:{durationSteps:number;fadeSteps:number;tongueCount:number;tongueWidth:number;tongueHeight:number;tongueSpacing:number;flickerSteps:number;emberCount:number;emberRise:number;contactRadius:number}. CosmeticDef.mods adds optional damageMult,previewMult,explosionRadiusMult,poisonChance,curseChance:number. CosmeticDef adds upgrade?:{stat:'launchSpeedMult'|'twinFraction'|'curseChance'|'damageMult'|'explosionRadiusMult'|'poisonChance';perLevel:number;prices:number[]}. No Arena type changes.

Import Ent type. Add ignite(b:BattleState,e:Ent):void, guarding dead, only block/monster, and feature burningVisuals; refresh e.burningUntil=b.steps+b.tune.status.burning.durationSteps; create one e.burningFx graphics at sprite depth+1 only if absent. Add syncBurning(b,e):void called from render: if expired/dead destroy and unset graphics; otherwise redraw same graphics at sprite x/y/rotation, scale matching sprite scale; alpha=min(1,(until-b.steps)/fadeSteps). Draw configured tongueCount (3) pixel tongues at local top=-e.h/2 with configured spacing/width/height, red base/orange/yellow core; deterministic flicker from floor(b.steps/flickerSteps)+index alternating heights (no gameplay RNG), and configured emberCount small yellow/orange rects looping upward by emberRise with different phase. All sizes/duration use data fields; geometric halves and unit pixel raster constants allowed. Add igniteNear(b,x,y,r): iterate living block/monster entities distance <=r+max(w,h)/2 then ignite. bolt calls igniteNear at impact endpoint with burning.contactRadius. flameBlast calls igniteNear with supplied r initially. electricField calls igniteNear with r initially. Do not change existing FX behavior or RNG.

Import ignite from fx. inflict uses b instead of _b; when kind burn, call ignite(b,e) and extend e.burningUntil to max(current,b.steps+steps) so burn visuals last full existing burn duration. Preserve existing burn damage/ticks completely, remove only old every-6-step single burst to avoid duplicate old burn sparks; other statuses unchanged.
Import text from art/font5x7. Add fx.label implementation (x,y,value)=>text(b.scene,x,y,value).setDepth(13). Existing interface new label used by Bulwark. No other actions needed.

Import ignite from fx. damage() after dead guard before shield return: if o.weaponId points to weapon with element hellfire or params.burningHit===1, ignite(b,t). discard destroys/clears burningFx. kill emits optional weaponId in kill payload. Preserve weapon identity across nonforge explosion damage by adding weaponId:wid??undefined to damage options. At explode entry if wid multiply r by b.mods.explosionRadiusMult??1. All weapon explosions (forge and nonforge) multiply dmg by b.mods.damageMult while preserving existing artifactMult application only for forged explosions. Enemy projectile collisions: retain existing friendly damage on monsters, but when shot.enemyBurning true and hit.ent alive block OR monster call ignite(b,hit.ent), without adding block damage. No other balance changes.

At forgeHit start after live guard, if t.kind==='monster', apply sling bonus chances once per hit: if (b.mods.poisonChance??0)>0 && b.rng.next()<chance set t.status.poison=b.tune.status.slingStatusSteps,t.params.poisonWeaponId=wid; similarly curseChance assigns t.status.curse same duration. When !w.forge path damage receives {...opts,weaponId:wid} (currently loses wid); rest of existing trait pipeline retained.
After enemy body creation set body.enemyBurning = o.shooter?.ent?.params?.burningAttack === 1. This is visual marking only. Source monsters own data params; no color/id checks.
In fieldActor's existing ctx.damage options add weaponId:p.wid so electric hits get centralized burning visual. Do not change field damage/status.

In countBounce stop rewriting damage for light mode; set p.body.proj.mul to p.data.damageMult (initial1). In onLaunch(ctx,p), initialize p.data.damageMult=1; set body.proj.mul=1; create label with ctx.fx.label current x1.0; create pulse overlay via ctx.fx.image same texture, tintFill white, alpha0 depth p.sprite.depth+1. Register ctx.events.on('kill') closure that ignores ended/inactive and anything except block whose weaponId===p.wid; then set damageMult=min(P.maxDamageMult,old*P.blockBreakMult), copy to body.proj.mul, set growthUntil=ctx.step+P.growthPulseSteps; replace existing label with freshly-created fx.label x${mult.toFixed(1)} (destroy old). Only pulse on actual increase. Add actor without pos to follow label at projectile body x,y-P.multiplierOffsetY and glow at sprite pose/scale; alpha=max(0,(growthUntil-ctx.step)/growthPulseSteps); finish when ended/inactive; destroy unsubscribes kill listener and destroys both label/glow. All branches damage from subsequent direct physical hits remain body.proj.mul. ShieldBlast calls ctx.blast with P.finalMult*(p.data.damageMult??1) so grown multiplier applies final blast. Keep mirror physics and bounce counts otherwise unchanged.

Import data. Preload optional frost_wolf_run strip as image key frost_wolf_run_strip with URL sprites/monsters/frost_wolf_run.png; existing failed load retry handles it safely. In create after retry branch and before scene start: if strip exists and frost_wolf_run doesn't, getSourceImage() as HTMLImageElement; size=height,count=width/height; if size>0 and count>=1 and integer use textures.addSpriteSheet('frost_wolf_run',source,{frameWidth:size,frameHeight:size,endFrame:count-1}). Create looping animation key frost_wolf_run if texture exists and animation absent, with frameRate=data.content.monsters.find(m=>m.id==='frost_wolf')!.params!.runFps, repeat:-1. Do not change fallback if optional strip unavailable; retries must never create placeholder sheet.
Only addMonster creates scene.add.sprite instead of image; makeEnt sprite argument union Image|Sprite to match Ent. All non-monster images unchanged.

Import syncBurning from fx and Phaser runtime for instanceof Sprite or use type assertion from import type Phaser. Render blocks/chests call syncBurning after sprite pose before continue. For monster render use Sprite union: wolf running animation selected when e.type==='frost_wolf', actual abs(body.velocity.x)>=e.params.runMinSpeed, runFrom defined and b.steps>=runFrom, statuses stun/chain<=0, and animation exists. Play frost_wolf_run only if not already playing; preserve desired display dimensions by setDisplaySize(e.size,e.size) for run frames. Otherwise stop running animation when playing then set existing tex (still frost_wolf); use normal size/scale when standing. Existing sync currently setTexture every frame; avoid that while running animation. Preserve flipX by direction. After final pose call syncBurning. Do not change gameplay runner logic.

acceptance_checks.command: OWNER ONLY: inspect Bulwark growth, burning refresh and moving/standing wolf animation on phone; no commands run in this task
acceptance_checks.expected: 20 bounces; x1.5 per disc block kill capped12; flame visual only with no duplicate; wolf6frames11fps when moving; fallback still when absent.
